purpose: Fast plausible demographic allocation without storing or processing a continental population raster.

method.step_1: Assign each macro-zone a sourced or explicitly estimated population anchor for the reference year.
method.step_2: Project the anchor to 2034 using the relevant national or regional demographic scenario.
method.step_3: Split each macro-zone between settlement classes using normalized weights, not a uniform density.
method.step_4: Distribute each class into the 25 km display cells using land area and settlement intensity weights.
method.step_5: Apply refuge capacity and access factors only after the population layer is complete.
method.step_6: Run low, central and high variants and preserve the parameter set with every result.

uncertainty_rules: Every unobserved parameter remains a scenario range, never a hidden point estimate.
The same person cannot be counted both in an existing refuge and in an improvised refuge.
A population anchor is not a survivor estimate.
The model must report sensitivity: which parameters move the result most.
The approximation is suitable for worldbuilding scale, not emergency planning or scientific forecasting.
open_decisions: whether refuge capacity is modelled per macro-zone or per display cell
